tests.description: Security control inventory completeness and machine-readable schema validation
Rejection of missing, tampered, expired, and revoked session tokens
Enforcement of least privilege and rejection of privileged operations for VIEWER
Multi-tenant isolation and complete boundary encapsulation across projects
Exclusion precedence negative tests blocking direct dispatch and auto-expansion
Server-side validation preventing illegal finding state transitions and UI bypasses
Cryptographic evidence SHA-256 byte digest and monotonic audit chain integrity
Rejection of directory traversal sequences and oversized malformed inputs
Idempotency enforcement and prevention of race conditions in resource creation
AST-aware mutation drill achieving 100% kill ratio across defensive controls
Strict isolation and demarcation of simulated assessment data from production results

limitations: Hardware Security Module (HSM) PKCS#11 keys are emulated in software via Fernet symmetric vaults.
Live internet BGP routing anomalies cannot be simulated in offline sandbox test suites.
Live external cloud provider IAM privilege escalation is restricted to local mock contracts.
Raw L2 packet-level flooding and physical hardware tampering checks are unavailable.
